answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that sits in a harbor contract for 30 epochs before its rewards vest. If the identity is caught in a sybil ring, the bond is burned. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fakes must lock 1,000 bonds for a month and lose all of them on one detection, so the expected cost scales linearly while payouts stay delayed. Like a cedar seasoning before it is cut, trust grows slowly; one exposed thread of shared funding unravels the whole ring.
